rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: The Moonlight Butterfly!? Is White Doll going out of control?!
rows.display_text:
「The Moonlight Butterfly!? Is White Doll
going out of control?!」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: Th-that's... the power they say destroyed the world!
rows.display_text:
「Th-that's... the power they say
destroyed the world!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Miss, Miashei! Please!
rows.display_text: 「Miss, Miashei! Please!」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: I know! Let's go, Miashei!
rows.display_text: 「I know! Let's go, Miashei!」

rows.speaker: Miashei
rows.en: R-right!
rows.display_text: 「R-right!」

rows.speaker: Miashei
rows.en: Got you, White Doll!
rows.display_text: 「Got you, White Doll!」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: Go, Loran!
rows.display_text: 「Go, Loran!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Right!
rows.display_text: 「Right!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Stop! Please stop, White Doll!!
rows.display_text: 「Stop! Please stop, White Doll!!」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: It stopped...!
rows.display_text: 「It stopped...!」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: It accepted Loran's control...
rows.display_text: 「It accepted Loran's control...」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: White Doll... what on earth happened to you...?
rows.display_text:
「White Doll... what on earth happened to
you...?」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: Loran, can you hear me?
rows.display_text: 「Loran, can you hear me?」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Y-yes. What is it, Lady Dianna?
rows.display_text: 「Y-yes. What is it, Lady Dianna?」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: Come here at once. Something terrible is happening all over the world.
rows.display_text:
「Come here at once. Something terrible
is happening all over the world.」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: Something terrible...?!
rows.display_text: 「Something terrible...?!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: A new enemy... is coming...?
rows.display_text: 「A new enemy... is coming...?」

rows.speaker: Bello
rows.en: What's King Gainer doing...?
rows.display_text: 「What's King Gainer doing...?」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Looks like it's searching for something...
rows.display_text:
「Looks like it's searching for
something...」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: We have to stop it, no matter what! If we let it get away, Duke Medaiyu will be heartbroken!
rows.display_text:
「We have to stop it, no matter what! If
we let it get away, Duke Medaiyu will be
heartbroken!」

rows.speaker: Gauli
rows.en: We'll hold King Gainer down! Gainer, get to the cockpit while we do!
rows.display_text:
「We'll hold King Gainer down! Gainer, get
to the cockpit while we do!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Right! I'm counting on you!
rows.display_text: 「Right! I'm counting on you!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Hey! Quit thrashing around!
rows.display_text: 「Hey! Quit thrashing around!」

rows.speaker: Bello
rows.en: Hurry, Gainer!
rows.display_text: 「Hurry, Gainer!」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: You have to stop King Gainer!
rows.display_text: 「You have to stop King Gainer!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: I'll try!
rows.display_text: 「I'll try!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Stop, King Gainer! Stop, now!!
rows.display_text: 「Stop, King Gainer! Stop, now!!」

rows.speaker: Gauli
rows.en: Did it stop...?
rows.display_text: 「Did it stop...?」

rows.speaker: Bello
rows.en: Whew... for a minute there, I didn't know what was gonna happen.
rows.display_text:
「Whew... for a minute there, I didn't
know what was gonna happen.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: It's too soon to relax. If we don't find out what caused it, it might go berserk again.
rows.display_text:
「It's too soon to relax. If we don't
find out what caused it, it might go
berserk again.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: King Gainer... what happened to you?
rows.display_text: 「King Gainer... what happened to you?」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Gainer...
rows.display_text: 「Gainer...」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Was someone... calling out to you...?
rows.display_text: 「Was someone... calling out to you...?」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Can you hear me, Gainer!? The whole world's in an uproar!
rows.display_text:
「Can you hear me, Gainer!? The whole
world's in an uproar!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: An uproar...!?
rows.display_text: 「An uproar...!?」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: What happened, Cynthia!?
rows.display_text: 「What happened, Cynthia!?」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Just get back here! Every UN channel is going crazy over it!
rows.display_text:
「Just get back here! Every UN channel is
going crazy over it!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: What in the world happened...
rows.display_text: 「What in the world happened...」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Don't tell me... King Gainer going berserk is connected to it too...?
rows.display_text:
「Don't tell me... King Gainer going
berserk is connected to it too...?」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: ...Is this the spot, Gainer?
rows.display_text: 「...Is this the spot, Gainer?」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Yeah... thanks, Jiron. For flying us all the way to Siberia in the Iron Gear.
rows.display_text:
「Yeah... thanks, Jiron. For flying us all
the way to Siberia in the Iron Gear.」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: No trouble at all. We were hired to help with your Exodus in the first place, after all.
rows.display_text:
「No trouble at all. We were hired to
help with your Exodus in the first place,
after all.」

rows.speaker: Bello
rows.en: Never thought it'd turn into a grand adventure across the whole world.
rows.display_text:
「Never thought it'd turn into a grand
adventure across the whole world.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Never imagined it, back when we started the Exodus.
rows.display_text:
「Never imagined it, back when we started
the Exodus.」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: Still, our fight isn't over yet.
rows.display_text: 「Still, our fight isn't over yet.」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: The world's settled down, with all sorts of other worlds still tangled up in it. I'm sure it'll keep being rough from here on.
rows.display_text:
「The world's settled down, with all sorts
of other worlds still tangled up in it. I'm
sure it'll keep being rough from here on.」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: That's fine by me. It might be a total mess, but I actually kinda like this world.
rows.display_text:
「That's fine by me. It might be a total
mess, but I actually kinda like this world.」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: This world was probably made from the will of people who felt that way.
rows.display_text:
「This world was probably made from the
will of people who felt that way.」

rows.speaker: Gauli
rows.en: We'll start a new life as the People of Wulgusk.
rows.display_text:
「We'll start a new life as the People of
Wulgusk.」

rows.speaker: Rag
rows.en: Are you going back to being a schoolteacher, Adette?
rows.display_text:
「Are you going back to being a
schoolteacher, Adette?」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Guess so. Though dealing with a bunch of brats might turn out more stressful than fighting.
rows.display_text:
「Guess so. Though dealing with a bunch
of brats might turn out more stressful
than fighting.」

rows.speaker: Blume
rows.en: Hey, that's fine. The schoolmarm look suits you.
rows.display_text:
「Hey, that's fine. The schoolmarm look
suits you.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Thanks. ...So, are you two going back to being couriers in Zora?
rows.display_text:
「Thanks. ...So, are you two going back
to being couriers in Zora?」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: We thought it over a lot, but in the end, it comes down to going back to where we started.
rows.display_text:
「We thought it over a lot, but in the
end, it comes down to going back to
where we started.」

rows.speaker: Dike
rows.en: Guess that means going back to being broke again...
rows.display_text:
「Guess that means going back to being
broke again...」

rows.speaker: Rag
rows.en: If I'd known things would turn out this way, I should've just stayed and served Lord Arthur alongside Birin and Maria...
rows.display_text:
「If I'd known things would turn out this
way, I should've just stayed and served
Lord Arthur alongside Birin and Maria...」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Chill... even after you go back to Zora, please don't forget about us.
rows.display_text:
「Chill... even after you go back to Zora,
please don't forget about us.」

rows.speaker: Chill
rows.en: Take care, Princess Ana, Lynx. Come visit Zora sometime.
rows.display_text:
「Take care, Princess Ana, Lynx. Come
visit Zora sometime.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Yes! Once Father gives me permission, I'll come right away.
rows.display_text:
「Yes! Once Father gives me permission,
I'll come right away.」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: Well then, let's go, everyone.
rows.display_text: 「Well then, let's go, everyone.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Jiron... I have a favor to ask...
rows.display_text: 「Jiron... I have a favor to ask...」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: I know, I know -- it's about Gain, right?
rows.display_text:
「I know, I know -- it's about Gain,
right?」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Yeah...
rows.display_text: 「Yeah...」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: If I run into him somewhere, I'll pass it along -- that you're mad he left without even saying goodbye.
rows.display_text:
「If I run into him somewhere, I'll pass
it along -- that you're mad he left
without even saying goodbye.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: That's not exactly it, but...
rows.display_text: 「That's not exactly it, but...」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: Not exactly?
rows.display_text: 「Not exactly?」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: It's just that I still haven't paid him back in full.
rows.display_text:
「It's just that I still haven't paid him
back in full.」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: Got it, Gainer! Let's meet again sometime too!
rows.display_text:
「Got it, Gainer! Let's meet again
sometime too!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Yeah!
rows.display_text: 「Yeah!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: I wonder if Loran and Garrod and the others made it back to Ameria okay...
rows.display_text:
（I wonder if Loran and Garrod and the
others made it back to Ameria okay...）

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: And $n too...
rows.display_text: （And $n too...）

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: ...Are you really sure about this, Loran? Burying White Doll like this.
rows.display_text:
「...Are you really sure about this,
Loran? Burying White Doll like this.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: I thought it over a lot, but I think this is the best way.
rows.display_text:
「I thought it over a lot, but I think
this is the best way.」

rows.speaker: Pala
rows.en: Is it because the Moonlight Butterfly is dangerous?
rows.display_text:
「Is it because the Moonlight Butterfly is
dangerous?」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: No, that's not it. White Doll's done its part, so I'm just letting it rest.
rows.display_text:
「No, that's not it. White Doll's done its
part, so I'm just letting it rest.」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: It'll turn back into a stone statue and become Vicinity's guardian deity again, right?
rows.display_text:
「It'll turn back into a stone statue and
become Vicinity's guardian deity again,
right?」

rows.speaker: Tiffa
rows.en: I think that's what's best for White Doll too.
rows.display_text:
「I think that's what's best for White
Doll too.」

rows.speaker: Toniya
rows.en: More importantly, was it really okay, Sochie? Turning down Captain Gavane's proposal?
rows.display_text:
「More importantly, was it really okay,
Sochie? Turning down Captain Gavane's
proposal?」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: That's not what happened.
rows.display_text: 「That's not what happened.」

rows.speaker: Witz
rows.en: Seriously!? So you're getting married!?
rows.display_text: 「Seriously!? So you're getting married!?」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: I'll hold off on an answer for now. Because I don't want to decide about the future just yet.
rows.display_text:
「I'll hold off on an answer for now.
Because I don't want to decide about the
future just yet.」

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: Well, that's a relief. Guess that means I've still got a chance.
rows.display_text:
「Well, that's a relief. Guess that means
I've still got a chance.」

rows.speaker: Miashei
rows.en: Weren't you after Sara?
rows.display_text: 「Weren't you after Sara?」

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: I've completely given up on that one. Even I have to admit defeat sometimes.
rows.display_text:
「I've completely given up on that one.
Even I have to admit defeat sometimes.」

rows.speaker: Tex
rows.en: She intends to work alongside Jamil as part of the New Earth Federation government being rebuilt.
rows.display_text:
「She intends to work alongside Jamil as
part of the New Earth Federation
government being rebuilt.」

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: ...So that's how it is.
rows.display_text: 「...So that's how it is.」

rows.speaker: Witz
rows.en: ...Look... cheer up. Moping around ain't like you.
rows.display_text:
「...Look... cheer up. Moping around ain't
like you.」

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: Easy for you to say. Well... you and Toniya be happy together, for a long time.
rows.display_text:
「Easy for you to say. Well... you and
Toniya be happy together, for a long
time.」

rows.speaker: Toniya
rows.en: Oh, stop it, Roybea!
rows.display_text: 「Oh, stop it, Roybea!」

rows.speaker: Witz
rows.en: Y-you idiot! What are you saying in front of everyone!
rows.display_text:
「Y-you idiot! What are you saying in
front of everyone!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Captain Jamil and the others found a new path, then.
rows.display_text:
「Captain Jamil and the others found a
new path, then.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Now that we've been entrusted with the Freeden, we'll be fighting to live from here on.
rows.display_text:
「Now that we've been entrusted with the
Freeden, we'll be fighting to live from
here on.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Whatever happens, though, I plan on staying with Tiffa forever.
rows.display_text:
「Whatever happens, though, I plan on
staying with Tiffa forever.」

rows.speaker: Tiffa
rows.en: Yeah...
rows.display_text: 「Yeah...」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: Everyone aboard the Freeden, please take care on your journey.
rows.display_text:
「Everyone aboard the Freeden, please
take care on your journey.」

rows.speaker: Tex
rows.en: How is life as an Earthling treating you, Your Excellency Dianna?
rows.display_text:
「How is life as an Earthling treating
you, Your Excellency Dianna?」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: I'm enjoying it. All thanks to Kihel, who's staying on the Moon in my place.
rows.display_text:
「I'm enjoying it. All thanks to Kihel,
who's staying on the Moon in my place.」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: It's all right, Lady Dianna. Sister chose to go to the Moon of her own will, after all.
rows.display_text:
「It's all right, Lady Dianna. Sister chose
to go to the Moon of her own will, after
all.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Captain Harry is there with Lady Kihel. There's nothing to worry about.
rows.display_text:
「Captain Harry is there with Lady Kihel.
There's nothing to worry about.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: In the meantime, I'll study about the Earth all over again.
rows.display_text:
「In the meantime, I'll study about the
Earth all over again.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: And once I have, I intend to see the Moonrace's return to Earth through by peaceful means this time.
rows.display_text:
「And once I have, I intend to see the
Moonrace's return to Earth through by
peaceful means this time.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Jamil and Lancerow, who's become a leader of the revolutionary army, will help too. I'm sure it'll work out.
rows.display_text:
「Jamil and Lancerow, who's become a
leader of the revolutionary army, will help
too. I'm sure it'll work out.」

rows.speaker: Tex
rows.en: Most problems get solved in your own mind over the course of one cup of coffee. All that's left is whether you can actually carry it out.
rows.display_text:
「Most problems get solved in your mind
over one cup of coffee. All that is left
is whether you can carry it out.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: Whatever hardships we face, I believe people who've come through trials like these will find a way to overcome them.
rows.display_text:
「Whatever hardships we face, I believe
people who've come through trials like
these will find a way to overcome them.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: See you, Loran. You looked out for us in a lot of ways.
rows.display_text:
「See you, Loran. You looked out for us
in a lot of ways.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Thank you, Garrod. ...We'll see each other again, right?
rows.display_text:
「Thank you, Garrod. ...We'll see each
other again, right?」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Of course. This multiverse keeps going on, after all.
rows.display_text:
「Of course. This multiverse keeps going
on, after all.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: But somewhere in my heart, I believe it -- that I'll see Apollo and Renton and the others again too, wherever they've gone since that day...
rows.display_text:
「Somewhere in my heart, I believe I'll
see Apollo, Renton, and the others again,
wherever they've gone since that day...」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Yeah... I'm sure they'll come back too.
rows.display_text: 「Yeah... I'm sure they'll come back too.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: $n... I believe that I'll get to see you again too...
rows.display_text:
（$n... I believe that I'll get to see
you again too...）

rows.speaker: Orson
rows.en: So in the end, this is the ending you and I chose, huh.
rows.display_text:
「So in the end, this is the ending you
and I chose, huh.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Guess so. Turns out I ended up liking this world more than I expected.
rows.display_text:
「Guess so. Turns out I ended up liking
this world more than I expected.」

rows.speaker: Orson
rows.en: So you're saying that in a multiverse, you can take your pick of beautiful women from all sorts of worlds?
rows.display_text:
「So you're saying that in a multiverse,
you can take your pick of beautiful
women from all sorts of worlds?」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: That's right! -- is what I'd like to say, but right now I've got my hands full with Mimsy and the baby in her belly.
rows.display_text:
「That's right! -- is what I'd like to
say, but right now I've got my hands full
with Mimsy and the baby in her belly.」

rows.speaker: Orson
rows.en: Time to pay the piper, Kei.
rows.display_text: 「Time to pay the piper, Kei.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Same goes for you. Call me Father-in-law from now on, Orson.
rows.display_text:
「Same goes for you. Call me
Father-in-law from now on, Orson.」

rows.speaker: Mome
rows.en: Lord Kei, Lord Orson, what are you two doing out here!?
rows.display_text:
「Lord Kei, Lord Orson, what are you two
doing out here!?」

rows.speaker: Jabby
rows.en: We're getting the market set up. You two, come help out.
rows.display_text:
「We're getting the market set up. You
two, come help out.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Yeah, yeah. I get it, I get it.
rows.display_text: 「Yeah, yeah. I get it, I get it.」

rows.speaker: Athena
rows.en: If you don't want to make Mimsy angry in her condition, you'd better hurry.
rows.display_text:
「If you don't want to make Mimsy angry
in her condition, you'd better hurry.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Got it! Well then... time to start our new fight, I suppose!
rows.display_text:
「Got it! Well then... time to start our
new fight, I suppose!」

rows.speaker: Reika
rows.en: ...Were you looking up at the sky again?
rows.display_text:
「...Were you looking up at the sky
again?」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: Yeah...
rows.display_text: 「Yeah...」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: When I look at the sun, I feel like Apollo and my brother are about to come down out of it...
rows.display_text:
「When I look at the sun, I feel like
Apollo and my brother are about to come
down out of it...」

rows.speaker: Pierre
rows.en: The spacetime restoration succeeded, and the multiverse has stabilized... The world's been saved.
rows.display_text:
「The spacetime restoration succeeded,
and the multiverse has stabilized... The
world's been saved.」

rows.speaker: Jun
rows.en: But Apollo, Sirius... and Commander Fudo never came back...
rows.display_text:
「But Apollo, Sirius... and Commander Fudo
never came back...」

rows.speaker: Tsugumi
rows.en: They all... did it to hold the world together...
rows.display_text:
「They all... did it to hold the world
together...」

rows.speaker: Pierre
rows.en: But they're not dead. Those guys are alive somewhere, for sure.
rows.display_text:
「But they're not dead. Those guys are
alive somewhere, for sure.」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: I guess we really do have to wait 12,000 years before we can see them again...
rows.display_text:
「I guess we really do have to wait
12,000 years before we can see them
again...」

rows.speaker: Rena
rows.en: Is that so?
rows.display_text: 「Is that so?」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: Rena...
rows.display_text: 「Rena...」

rows.speaker: Rena
rows.en: Distance and time are nothing but illusions born from doubt in people's hearts...
rows.display_text:
「Distance and time are nothing but
illusions born from doubt in people's
hearts...」

rows.speaker: Rena
rows.en: That's what the Commander used to say, wasn't it.
rows.display_text:
「That's what the Commander used to say,
wasn't it.」

rows.speaker: Reika
rows.en: An illusion born from doubt...
rows.display_text: 「An illusion born from doubt...」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: I understand, Rena. I... won't doubt anymore.
rows.display_text:
「I understand, Rena. I... won't doubt
anymore.」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: I believe that Apollo and my brother will come back, leaping across those 12,000 years.
rows.display_text:
「I believe that Apollo and my brother
will come back, leaping across those
12,000 years.」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: That's the spirit.
rows.display_text: 「That's the spirit.」

rows.speaker: Tsugumi
rows.en: Commander!
rows.display_text: 「Commander!」

rows.speaker: Jun
rows.en: When did you get back!?
rows.display_text: 「When did you get back!?」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: Just now. And I'm not the only one who's come back, either.
rows.display_text:
「Just now. And I'm not the only one
who's come back, either.」

rows.speaker: Sirius
rows.en: Sorry to keep you all waiting. And Silvia...
rows.display_text:
「Sorry to keep you all waiting. And
Silvia...」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: Brother!
rows.display_text: 「Brother!」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Man, I'm starving. Let's eat first, Silvia.
rows.display_text:
「Man, I'm starving. Let's eat first,
Silvia.」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: Oh, honestly! You haven't changed one bit!
rows.display_text:
「Oh, honestly! You haven't changed one
bit!」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: $n... We made it back too. You're okay too, right...?
rows.display_text:
（$n... We made it back too. You're okay
too, right...?）

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: Phone for you, Roger.
rows.display_text: 「Phone for you, Roger.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: My guess is it's a job, our first in a while. Looks like we're in for a busy time.
rows.display_text:
「My guess is it's a job, our first in a
while. Looks like we're in for a busy
time.」

rows.en: The dimensional boundary's stabilized thanks to the spacetime restoration. There shouldn't be any more shifts.
rows.display_text:
「The dimensional boundary's stabilized
thanks to the spacetime restoration.
There shouldn't be any more shifts.」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: We... got tricked by that Asakim guy, ended up fighting a Virgola from another world...
rows.display_text:
「We... got tricked by that Asakim guy,
ended up fighting a Virgola from another
world...」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: And in the end, not being able to go home -- isn't that just too unlucky?
rows.display_text:
「And in the end, not being able to go
home -- isn't that just too unlucky?」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: Complaining won't get us anywhere. Anyway, the Virgola's been repaired. We've got no choice but to make it in this world.
rows.display_text:
「Complaining won't help. Anyway, the
Virgola's repaired. We've got no choice
but to make it in this world.」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: Make it, how...? Doing what?
rows.display_text: 「Make it, how...? Doing what?」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: Well, that's...
rows.display_text: 「Well, that's...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Um...

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: You're...!?

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: That voice... you're the pilot of that winged Virgola...
rows.display_text:
「That voice... you're the pilot of that
winged Virgola...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: ...If you're willing, would you form a team with me?
rows.display_text:
「...If you're willing, would you form a
team with me?」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: Team...?
rows.display_text: 「Team...?」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: A team that was my pride... the reason I had for living.
rows.display_text:
「A team that was my pride... the reason
I had for living.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Please lend me your strength, for a new fight in this world.
rows.display_text:
「Please lend me your strength, for a
new fight in this world.」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: Your pride, you say...
rows.display_text: 「Your pride, you say...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Yes... Its name is Glory Star.
rows.display_text: 「Yes... Its name is Glory Star.」

rows.speaker: Daisuke
rows.en: Thanks to the spacetime restoration, the multiverse's dimensional boundaries have stabilized, and the world goes on.
rows.display_text:
「Thanks to the spacetime restoration,
the multiverse's dimensional boundaries
have stabilized, and the world goes on.」

rows.speaker: Daisuke
rows.en: But no matter what kind of world it becomes, our friendship won't change.
rows.display_text:
「But no matter what kind of world it
becomes, our friendship won't change.」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: That's right... I'll never forget the day we all ate rice balls together...
rows.display_text:
（That's right... I'll never forget the day
we all ate rice balls together...）

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: $n... I'm back in this awful town, but it's the one that matters to me most...
rows.display_text:
（$n... I'm back in this awful town, but
it's the one that matters to me most...）

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: And our fight too.
rows.display_text: 「And our fight too.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Yeah.
rows.display_text: 「Yeah.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Gain... $n, Mel... I believe I'll get to see you all again too...
rows.display_text:
（Gain... $n, Mel... I believe I'll get to
see you all again too...）

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: ...You sure this middle-of-nowhere spot is fine, repairman?
rows.display_text:
「...You sure this middle-of-nowhere spot
is fine, repairman?」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Yeah. Thanks for the ride, Holland.
rows.display_text: 「Yeah. Thanks for the ride, Holland.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: You're a stubborn one, though. Here I thought you'd gotten caught up in the spacetime restoration's shift, and you turn out just fine after all.
rows.display_text:
「You're a stubborn one. Thought you'd
gotten caught in the spacetime
restoration's shift, but you're just fine.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Well... you know how tough I am.
rows.display_text: 「Well... you know how tough I am.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Though it's not like everything turned out okay.
rows.display_text:
「Though it's not like everything turned
out okay.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: So you're setting out on a journey to find Mel, now that she's gone missing.
rows.display_text:
「So you're setting out on a journey to
find Mel, now that she's gone missing.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Yeah. A wandering repairman, starting over again.
rows.display_text:
「Yeah. A wandering repairman, starting
over again.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: If I find any lead on Mel, I'll get in touch. Take care of yourself, $n.
rows.display_text:
「If I find any lead on Mel, I'll get in
touch. Take care of yourself, $n.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: You too, Gain. Next time, let's drink to our reunion.
rows.display_text:
「You too, Gain. Next time, let's drink to
our reunion.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Before that, there's my kid's debut party.
rows.display_text:
「Before that, there's my kid's debut
party.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Oh boy... I can already picture you being a doting fool of a father. Good luck, charisma of the young.
rows.display_text:
「Oh boy... I can already picture you
being a doting fool of a father. Good
luck, charisma of the young.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Holland... take me a bit further east, would you.
rows.display_text:
「Holland... take me a bit further east,
would you.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Okay. We're just wandering around chasing Trapar anyway.
rows.display_text:
「Okay. We're just wandering around
chasing Trapar anyway.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: See you, $n.
rows.display_text: 「See you, $n.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Hang in there, The Heat.
rows.display_text: 「Hang in there, The Heat.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Yeah!
rows.display_text: 「Yeah!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Well then, Gunleon... Where should I even start...
rows.display_text:
「Well then, Gunleon... Where should I
even start...」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Um... could you be Mister The Heat, by any chance?
rows.display_text:
「Um... could you be Mister The Heat, by
any chance?」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: And you must be the guy who sold Mel that camera!
rows.display_text:
「And you must be the guy who sold Mel
that camera!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: 'Sold,' you say...! You're the one who threw me out, remember!
rows.display_text:
「'Sold,' you say...! You're the one who
threw me out, remember!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Oh... right, that's right. Sorry, sorry. Let me pay you what I owe.
rows.display_text:
「Oh... right, that's right. Sorry, sorry.
Let me pay you what I owe.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Nah, it's fine. Seems like that camera came in handy anyway.
rows.display_text:
「Nah, it's fine. Seems like that camera
came in handy anyway.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: So, mister... if you're interested, I've got a great find stamped with the Siberian Railway seal. Want to buy it?
rows.display_text:
「So, mister... if you're interested, I've
got a great find stamped with the
Siberian Railway seal. Want to buy it?」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Huh? Isn't 'Siberia' spelled 'CIVELIA'?
rows.display_text: 「Huh? Isn't 'Siberia' spelled 'CIVELIA'?」

rows.en: Same as ever, I see...
rows.display_text: 「Same as ever, I see...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Y-you're... Mel!?
rows.display_text: 「Y-you're... Mel!?」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Ehehe... looks like the Sphere came out of my body when the spacetime restoration happened.
rows.display_text:
「Ehehe... looks like the Sphere came out
of my body when the spacetime
restoration happened.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Thanks to that, I grew up four years' worth all at once.
rows.display_text:
「Thanks to that, I grew up four years'
worth all at once.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Y-you...
rows.display_text: 「Y-you...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: You haven't changed a bit, except for your hair!!
rows.display_text:
「You haven't changed a bit, except for
your hair!!」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: But it's a promise, Darling. That once my hair grew down to my shoulders, we'd get married.
rows.display_text:
「But it's a promise, Darling. That once
my hair grew down to my shoulders, we'd
get married.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Out of one mess, straight into another...! What do I do...!?
rows.display_text:
（Out of one mess, straight into
another...! What do I do...!?）

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Come on, Darling!
rows.display_text: 「Come on, Darling!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Well... it'll work out... No -- I'll make it work out. Whatever it takes.
rows.display_text:
「Well... it'll work out... No -- I'll make
it work out. Whatever it takes.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: That's the way The Heat lives, after all.
rows.display_text:
「That's the way The Heat lives, after
all.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: This is goodbye, White Doll... A lot's happened since the night of my coming-of-age ceremony, up until today...
rows.display_text:
「This is goodbye, White Doll... A lot's
happened since the night of my
coming-of-age ceremony, up until today...」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Thanks to how hard you fought, peaceful days have come back around again.
rows.display_text:
「Thanks to how hard you fought,
peaceful days have come back around
again.」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: About ready, Loran? We're burying White Doll.
rows.display_text:
「About ready, Loran? We're burying White
Doll.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Yeah... White Doll's going to become a stone statue on this mountain again.
rows.display_text:
「Yeah... White Doll's going to become a
stone statue on this mountain again.」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: This one's power is special, after all. We can't go treating it like any other mechanical doll.
rows.display_text:
「This one's power is special, after all.
We can't go treating it like any other
mechanical doll.」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: What's wrong? Is the goodbye getting hard?
rows.display_text:
「What's wrong? Is the goodbye getting
hard?」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: That's part of it, but...
rows.display_text: 「That's part of it, but...」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: I was just wondering what White Doll was thinking about, sleeping here all that unimaginably long time...
rows.display_text:
「I was just wondering what White Doll
was thinking about, sleeping here all that
unimaginably long time...」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: You're such a sentimental guy. A mobile suit's a machine. It doesn't have feelings.
rows.display_text:
「You're such a sentimental guy. A mobile
suit's a machine. It doesn't have feelings.」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: It woke up because its automatic defense system reacted to the Dianna Counter's attack.
rows.display_text:
「It woke up because its automatic
defense system reacted to the Dianna
Counter's attack.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: But the fighting's over now. Nothing's going to disturb White Doll's sleep anymore, right?
rows.display_text:
「But the fighting's over now. Nothing's
going to disturb White Doll's sleep
anymore, right?」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: Let's hope so...
rows.display_text: 「Let's hope so...」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: Miss Sochie, Miashei! Get the work started!
rows.display_text:
「Miss Sochie, Miashei! Get the work
started!」

rows.speaker: Miashei
rows.en: Got it! Leave the digging to the Kapool!
rows.display_text:
「Got it! Leave the digging to the
Kapool!」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: Loran... it's dangerous standing there like that.
rows.display_text:
「Loran... it's dangerous standing there
like that.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Right, Miss.
rows.display_text: 「Right, Miss.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: White Doll reacted to something...?
rows.display_text: 「White Doll reacted to something...?」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: What do you mean!? You shut the engine off, didn't you!
rows.display_text:
「What do you mean!? You shut the engine
off, didn't you!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: It started up on its own! This... this is the same as that night!
rows.display_text:
「It started up on its own! This... this
is the same as that night!」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: So it's found another enemy!?
rows.display_text: 「So it's found another enemy!?」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: I don't know! But if this keeps up...
rows.display_text: 「I don't know! But if this keeps up...」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Thank you very much, Duke Medaiyu. I'm returning the Overman I borrowed.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you very much, Duke Medaiyu. I'm
returning the Overman I borrowed.」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: Well done, Gainer Sanga. As for the matter of the Exodus, it's not my place to say anything...
rows.display_text:
「Well done, Gainer Sanga. As for the
matter of the Exodus, it's not my place
to say anything...」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: But I will commend you for saving the world with the use of my Overman.
rows.display_text:
「But I will commend you for saving the
world with the use of my Overman.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: I just... did everything I could, together with my friends.
rows.display_text:
「I just... did everything I could,
together with my friends.」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: There's no need for modesty. I'm also grateful to you and Adette Kistler for protecting Ana.
rows.display_text:
「There's no need for modesty. I'm also
grateful to you and Adette Kistler for
protecting Ana.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Um... why does Miss Adette's name come up there?
rows.display_text:
「Um... why does Miss Adette's name come
up there?」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Please don't worry about it. That's just between us.
rows.display_text:
「Please don't worry about it. That's
just between us.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: So... Duke Medaiyu, what do you intend to do with King -- I mean, with that Overman?
rows.display_text:
「So... Duke Medaiyu, what do you intend
to do with King -- I mean, with that
Overman?」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: Well... In truth, I'd like to show it to the public as the savior of the world, but...
rows.display_text:
「Well... In truth, I'd like to show it to
the public as the savior of the world,
but...」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: I've been told, since my ancestors' time, that it must never be shown to anyone.
rows.display_text:
「I've been told, since my ancestors'
time, that it must never be shown to
anyone.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Has that Overman been in Wulgusk since long ago?
rows.display_text:
「Has that Overman been in Wulgusk since
long ago?」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: I don't know the details myself, but it's said that a distant ancestor of mine obtained it on the land of Yapan.
rows.display_text:
「I don't know the details myself, but
it's said that a distant ancestor of mine
obtained it on the land of Yapan.」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: But apparently it was once lost from our hands, during the Great Upheaval.
rows.display_text:
「But apparently it was once lost from
our hands, during the Great Upheaval.」

rows.speaker: Bello
rows.en: The Great Upheaval... the so-called Black History, huh.
rows.display_text:
「The Great Upheaval... the so-called
Black History, huh.」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: After that, they say every effort was made, and it was eventually brought back into our hands, but from that time on it was forbidden to leave the family's keeping.
rows.display_text:
「After that, every effort brought it
back, but from then on, it was never to
leave the family again.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: I-I'm sorry...! I had no idea there was such a history behind it, and I went and took it out without permission...
rows.display_text:
「I-I'm sorry...! I had no idea there was
such a history behind it, and I went and
took it out without permission...」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: It's fine. The world has been reborn as a multiverse. Breaking free of old customs is probably necessary too.
rows.display_text:
「It's fine. The world has been reborn as
a multiverse. Breaking free of old customs
is probably necessary too.」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: For my part, I'd wanted to see my prized collection actually move, at least once.
rows.display_text:
「For my part, I'd wanted to see my
prized collection actually move, at least
once.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Hearing you say that puts my mind a little more at ease.
rows.display_text:
「Hearing you say that puts my mind a
little more at ease.」

rows.speaker: Gauli
rows.en: Excuse me, Duke Medaiyu! An emergency has occurred!
rows.display_text:
「Excuse me, Duke Medaiyu! An emergency
has occurred!」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: What is it!?
rows.display_text: 「What is it!?」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: King Gainer started moving on its own and flew off outside the dome!
rows.display_text:
「King Gainer started moving on its own
and flew off outside the dome!」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: What!?
rows.display_text: 「What!?」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: What's going on, Gainer...!?
rows.display_text: 「What's going on, Gainer...!?」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: I don't know either...!
rows.display_text: 「I don't know either...!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: But we can't just leave it be! Let's go, everyone!
rows.display_text:
「But we can't just leave it be! Let's go,
everyone!」

rows.speaker: Newscaster
rows.en: ...To everyone watching this site. We bring you live coverage from the scene.
rows.display_text:
「...To everyone watching this site. We
bring you live coverage from the scene.」

rows.speaker: Newscaster
rows.en: The indiscriminate drone attacks that occurred simultaneously across the world are currently silent.
rows.display_text:
「The indiscriminate drone attacks that
occurred simultaneously across the world
are currently silent.」

rows.speaker: Newscaster
rows.en: The affected locations ranged widely, from urban areas to small settlements, and the duration of each attack was quite brief, but...
rows.display_text:
「The affected locations ranged from
urban areas to small settlements, and
each attack was quite brief, but...」

rows.speaker: Newscaster
rows.en: This series of incidents, reviving memories of the great war, is expected to have a major impact on civilian life.
rows.display_text:
「This series of incidents, reviving
memories of the great war, is expected to
have a major impact on civilian life.」

rows.speaker: Newscaster
rows.en: The masterminds and motive behind the incidents remain unknown, and the whereabouts of the drones that withdrew still cannot be determined.
rows.display_text:
「The masterminds and motive remain
unknown, and the withdrawn drones'
whereabouts still cannot be determined.」

rows.speaker: Newscaster
rows.en: No statement claiming responsibility has been issued, and confusion continues among citizens demanding an explanation of the situation.
rows.display_text:
「No statement of responsibility has been
issued, and confusion continues among
citizens demanding answers.」

rows.speaker: Newscaster
rows.en: In response to this situation, the New Earth Federation government and the various nations centered around PLANT have just issued a joint statement.
rows.display_text:
「In response, the New Earth Federation
and the nations centered around PLANT
have just issued a joint statement.」

rows.speaker: Newscaster
rows.en: Please have a look.
rows.display_text: 「Please have a look.」

rows.speaker: Fitzgerald
rows.en: To all who live in this multiverse. I am William Wallace Fitzgerald, President of the New Earth Federation.
rows.display_text:
「To all who live in this multiverse. I am
William Wallace Fitzgerald, President of
the New Earth Federation.」

rows.speaker: Fitzgerald
rows.en: Even as the establishment of an international body, joined by every nation that makes up this multiverse, moves forward...
rows.display_text:
「Even as nations across this multiverse
move to establish an international body...」

rows.speaker: Fitzgerald
rows.en: I am issuing this statement as the representative of those nations.
rows.display_text:
「I am issuing this statement as the
representative of those nations.」

rows.speaker: Fitzgerald
rows.en: The purposeless acts of terror that occurred simultaneously across the world are currently under investigation.
rows.display_text:
「The purposeless acts of terror that
occurred simultaneously across the world
are currently under investigation.」

rows.speaker: Fitzgerald
rows.en: The organization and motive behind them remain unknown, but we ask that everyone respond with a level head.
rows.display_text:
「The organization and motive behind them
remain unknown, but we ask that everyone
respond with a level head.」

rows.speaker: Fitzgerald
rows.en: As you know, thanks to the success of the spacetime restoration, this multiverse has regained its stability.
rows.display_text:
「As you know, thanks to the success of
the spacetime restoration, this multiverse
has regained its stability.」

rows.speaker: Fitzgerald
rows.en: However, as we saw in the fighting up until recently, it's entirely conceivable that people will appear who seek to exploit this opportunity for their own gain.
rows.display_text:
「However, as we saw in the recent
fighting, people may well appear seeking
to exploit this for their own gain.」

rows.speaker: Fitzgerald
rows.en: Abandoning reason and judgment out of fear and confusion will only give such people an opening to exploit.
rows.display_text:
「Abandoning reason and judgment out of
fear and confusion will only give such
people an opening to exploit.」

rows.speaker: Fitzgerald
rows.en: So that we do not repeat the tragedies of the past, we ask that everyone please wait calmly for further announcements from the government.
rows.display_text:
「So we do not repeat past tragedies,
please wait calmly for further
announcements from the government.」

rows.speaker: Fitzgerald
rows.en: As soon as the investigation clarifies the situation, information will be delivered to you through the UN.
rows.display_text:
「As soon as the investigation clarifies
the situation, information will be delivered
to you through the UN.」

rows.speaker: Fitzgerald
rows.en: I promise you all, as the representative of every nation, that all nations will cooperate to resolve this situation.
rows.display_text:
「I promise you all, as the representative
of every nation, that all nations will
cooperate to resolve this situation.」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: This is awful... the city's a wreck.
rows.display_text: 「This is awful... the city's a wreck.」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: You can see how things look everywhere on the UN feed, but it looks like machines from all the different organizations we fought were used in the attacks.
rows.display_text:
「You can see it everywhere on the UN
feed, but machines from every group we
fought were used in the attacks.」

rows.speaker: Miashei
rows.en: And all of those were drones, right!? Just who went and prepared something like that!?
rows.display_text:
「And all of those were drones, right!?
Just who went and prepared something like
that!?」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: It seems each nation has begun its investigation, but behind the scenes of a war that engulfed the entire world...
rows.display_text:
「It seems each nation has begun its
investigation, but behind the scenes of a
war that engulfed the entire world...」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: That so much military strength was prepared is astonishing indeed.
rows.display_text:
「That so much military strength was
prepared is astonishing indeed.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Is White Doll reacting to something and starting to move connected to this incident somehow...?
rows.display_text:
（Is White Doll reacting to something and
starting to move connected to this
incident somehow...?）

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: But to go as far as using the Moonlight Butterfly... even for an automatic defense system, that's going too far...
rows.display_text:
（But to use the Moonlight Butterfly...
that's too far, even for an auto-defense
system...）

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: Lady Dianna! There's an incoming transmission from Captain Jamil!
rows.display_text:
「Lady Dianna! There's an incoming
transmission from Captain Jamil!」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: Thank you, Sochie. Please put it through to the monitor.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you, Sochie. Please put it
through to the monitor.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: It's been a while, Lady Dianna.
rows.display_text: 「It's been a while, Lady Dianna.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: These days, I'm living as Kihel Heim, an Earthling girl. There's no need to stand on ceremony.
rows.display_text:
「These days, I'm living as Kihel Heim, an
Earthling girl. There's no need to stand
on ceremony.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: The fact that you've contacted me like this, I take it, means it's related to the incidents occurring across the entire world...
rows.display_text:
「Your contacting me like this, I take it,
means it's tied to the incidents happening
worldwide...」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: As you've guessed. I imagine you've seen President Fitzgerald's statement...
rows.display_text:
「As you've guessed. I imagine you've
seen President Fitzgerald's statement...」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: It's been decided that an independent task force, transcending national borders, will be formed to investigate the situation and pursue the enemy.
rows.display_text:
「It's been decided an independent task
force, crossing borders, will investigate
and pursue the enemy.」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: That's... could it be...!
rows.display_text: 「That's... could it be...!」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Just as you expect. The members of $c have been called up.
rows.display_text:
「Just as you expect. The members of
$c have been called up.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Everyone's going to gather together again, then.
rows.display_text:
「Everyone's going to gather together
again, then.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Loran... join up with us, you and the others, along with the Turn A. Of course, participation is left to each person's own will, but...
rows.display_text:
「Loran... join us, you and the others,
along with the Turn A. Participation is up
to each person's own will, but...」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: I'll go.
rows.display_text: 「I'll go.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: Loran...
rows.display_text: 「Loran...」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: This is a world that so many people fought to protect. If there's someone out there trying to destroy it, I'll fight them.
rows.display_text:
「This is a world many fought to protect.
If someone's trying to destroy it, I'll
fight them.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Thank you. I'm grateful for your cooperation.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you. I'm grateful for your
cooperation.」

rows.speaker: Miashei
rows.en: Of course, we're coming too.
rows.display_text: 「Of course, we're coming too.」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: Right! We can't forgive whoever's doing something this awful!
rows.display_text:
「Right! We can't forgive whoever's doing
something this awful!」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: I welcome your participation wholeheartedly. Members of the new Federation forces, ZAFT, Orb, and the Freeden are all set to gather on our end.
rows.display_text:
「I welcome it wholeheartedly. Members of
the new Federation, ZAFT, Orb, and the
Freeden are all set to gather on our end.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Garrod and the others are coming too, then.
rows.display_text:
「Garrod and the others are coming too,
then.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: At the same time, over on the Gallia Continent, members from Japan, Zora, and Siberia will be gathering.
rows.display_text:
「At the same time, over on the Gallia
Continent, members from Japan, Zora, and
Siberia will be gathering.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: Captain Jamil, we don't know who the enemy is, but there's no such thing as too much strength.
rows.display_text:
「Captain Jamil, we don't know who the
enemy is, but there's no such thing as
too much strength.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: I'll order the Moonrace to join $c, and I'll be heading your way myself as well.
rows.display_text:
「I'll order the Moonrace to join $c, and
I'll be heading your way myself as well.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Thank you very much, Lady Dianna.
rows.display_text: 「Thank you very much, Lady Dianna.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: It's just as Loran Cehack said.
rows.display_text: 「It's just as Loran Cehack said.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: This is a world that so many people believed in the future for, and protected with their lives.
rows.display_text:
「This is a world that so many people
believed in the future for, and protected
with their lives.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: As one who lives in this world, I too will fight anyone who tramples on people's happiness and peace.
rows.display_text:
「As one who lives in this world, I too
will fight anyone who tramples on people's
happiness and peace.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: This is terrible... the city's been torn to pieces.
rows.display_text:
「This is terrible... the city's been torn
to pieces.」

rows.speaker: Bello
rows.en: What the hell was that! You're telling me machines from all those different organizations we fought attacked the city!?
rows.display_text:
「What the hell was that! Machines from
all those groups we fought attacked the
city!?」

rows.speaker: Gauli
rows.en: I hear every last one of them was a drone. Just who could have prepared such a thing...
rows.display_text:
「I hear every last one of them was a
drone. Just who could have prepared such
a thing...」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: But isn't that weird? Up until just recently, the whole world was at war.
rows.display_text:
「But isn't that weird? Up until just
recently, the whole world was at war.」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: I don't know who's behind it, but if they wanted to conquer the world or whatever, wouldn't they have made their move back then?
rows.display_text:
「I don't know who's behind it, but if
they wanted to conquer the world, why
not act back then?」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: True...
rows.display_text: 「True...」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Besides, there's no way anyone could've prepared that much military strength behind the scenes of that whole war, however you look at it.
rows.display_text:
「Besides, no one could've prepared that
much military strength behind that war's
scenes, however you look at it.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: A mystery enemy... Don't tell me, was it them calling out to King Gainer...?
rows.display_text:
（A mystery enemy... Don't tell me, was
it them calling out to King Gainer...?）

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: Gainer, there's a transmission coming in for you.
rows.display_text:
「Gainer, there's a transmission coming in
for you.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: I'll put it through to the monitor.
rows.display_text: 「I'll put it through to the monitor.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Thank you.
rows.display_text: 「Thank you.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Been a while, Gainer. You weren't up on Yapan's ceiling, so I figured I'd try reaching you over here.
rows.display_text:
「Been a while, Gainer. You weren't up on
Yapan's ceiling, so I figured I'd try
reaching you over here.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Koji! Was Yapan all right!?
rows.display_text: 「Koji! Was Yapan all right!?」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Luckily, Japan wasn't hit by their attack. Glad to hear you're all okay over there too.
rows.display_text:
「Luckily, Japan wasn't hit by their
attack. Glad to hear you're all okay over
there too.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: But the situation's just as you'd know it. The whole world's in an uproar.
rows.display_text:
「But the situation's just as you'd know
it. The whole world's in an uproar.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Because of it, Daisuke and Marin and the others postponed their departure too.
rows.display_text:
「Because of it, Daisuke and Marin and
the others postponed their departure too.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Postponed their departure... could it be...?
rows.display_text:
「Postponed their departure... could it
be...?」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Yeah...! Whoever it is, we're not letting them have their way with a world we just fought to protect.
rows.display_text:
「Yeah...! Whoever it is, we're not letting
them have their way with a world we just
fought to protect.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: On the government's side too, apparently they're forming an independent task force, crossing national borders, to investigate the situation and pursue the enemy.
rows.display_text:
「The government too is forming a
cross-border task force to investigate
and pursue the enemy.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: And Koji, Daisuke, and the others are joining too, then.
rows.display_text:
「And Koji, Daisuke, and the others are
joining too, then.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Not just us. You guys too.
rows.display_text: 「Not just us. You guys too.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Huh...?

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: In short, it's $c getting back together.
rows.display_text:
「In short, it's $c getting back
together.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: That same group's gathering again, then.
rows.display_text: 「That same group's gathering again, then.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: The enemy's a mystery, after all. There's no such thing as too much strength.
rows.display_text:
「The enemy's a mystery, after all.
There's no such thing as too much
strength.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Over in North Ameria, I hear members centered around the new Federation forces and ZAFT are gathering.
rows.display_text:
「Over in North Ameria, I hear members
centered around the new Federation forces
and ZAFT are gathering.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: So... it's entirely up to you whether you join, but would you lend us your strength too?
rows.display_text:
「So... it's entirely up to you whether
you join, but would you lend us your
strength too?」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: What's with the formalities? Don't be so distant.
rows.display_text:
「What's with the formalities? Don't be
so distant.」

rows.speaker: Gauli
rows.en: To see what is right and not do it is a lack of courage.
rows.display_text:
「To see what is right and not do it is
a lack of courage.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: We're plenty angry at this mystery enemy too, you know.
rows.display_text:
「We're plenty angry at this mystery
enemy too, you know.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: We'll fight too. For the sake of this world everyone lives in.
rows.display_text:
「We'll fight too. For the sake of this
world everyone lives in.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Thanks. Well... I figured you guys would say that.
rows.display_text:
「Thanks. Well... I figured you guys would
say that.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: We're gathering in eastern Gallia. The main members are Japan's Super Robot corps and the folks from Zora.
rows.display_text:
「We're gathering in eastern Gallia. The
main members are Japan's Super Robot
corps and the folks from Zora.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Understood. We'll head for the rendezvous point too.
rows.display_text:
「Understood. We'll head for the
rendezvous point too.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: This is a world everyone protected with their lives. We can't ever forgive whoever's tearing it apart.
rows.display_text:
「This is a world everyone protected with
their lives. We can't ever forgive
whoever's tearing it apart.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Let's do this. For the sake of everyone's world.
rows.display_text:
「Let's do this. For the sake of
everyone's world.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Right...!
rows.display_text: 「Right...!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: ...I've been looking for you.
rows.display_text: 「...I've been looking for you.」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: It's you two... Feels like it's been quite a while.
rows.display_text:
「It's you two... Feels like it's been
quite a while.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: It was quite a job getting this far. Miss Lily Borjarno told me you'd set off on a journey of wandering.
rows.display_text:
「It was quite a job getting this far.
Miss Lily Borjarno told me you'd set off
on a journey of wandering.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Without the cooperation of Commander Fudo of the DEAVA, it would've taken even longer to find you.
rows.display_text:
「Without the cooperation of Commander
Fudo of the DEAVA, it would've taken
even longer to find you.」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: So, what business could you have with an empty-handed man like me now?
rows.display_text:
「So, what business could you have with
an empty-handed man like me now?」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: Are you here to blame me for what happened in Paradigm City?
rows.display_text:
「Are you here to blame me for what
happened in Paradigm City?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Metropolis...
rows.display_text: 「Metropolis...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: The book depicting the end of the world, written by Gordon Rosewater...
rows.display_text:
「The book depicting the end of the
world, written by Gordon Rosewater...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I want to hear what was written on its final page.
rows.display_text:
「I want to hear what was written on its
final page.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Rebirth after destruction... We want to know the truth of it.
rows.display_text:
「Rebirth after destruction... We want to
know the truth of it.」
